modules.title: pg_stat_statements (deep)
goals: Use pg_stat_statements as workload evidence rather than as a dashboard ornament.
Connect normalized statement statistics to EXPLAIN, index, and deploy review workflows.
Bound the operational cost of collection, reset, and configuration choices.
exit_competencies: Rank workload pain by total time, mean time, calls, rows, and I/O counters.
Produce before and after baselines without erasing the evidence needed for review.
Diagnose configuration drift such as low pg_stat_statements.max or missing track_io_timing.

modules.title: pg_trgm
goals: Add typo-tolerant matching only when lexical search or btree lookup is not enough.
Choose GIN, GiST, or btree support from query shape and write cost evidence.
Combine trigrams with core full-text search without confusing their jobs.
exit_competencies: Use similarity, word_similarity, thresholds, and trigram operators deliberately.
Design support search and deduplication workflows with explainable thresholds.
Recognize when PostgreSQL trigram search should yield to a dedicated search engine.

modules.title: PostGIS
goals: Identify the workload signal that makes PostGIS worth considering.
Compare the PostgreSQL core alternative before adding operational burden.
Account for backup, replication, upgrade, and portability consequences.
exit_competencies: Explain where PostGIS fits and where not yet is the better answer.
Design a small proof that measures benefit and operating cost.
Document managed-service constraints before committing to production use.
